# Cardano PubSub

> Research and development of a Cardano-anchored publish/subscribe layer for
> authenticated ecosystem communication: signed messages, on-chain publication
> permissions and deposit-backed node membership. A research workstream by Input Output, not a production system.

The draft CIP selects M4 within the evaluated M1–M5 family: bidirectional links
with a verifiable eligibility rule and an admissions budget. The historical
comparisons study reachability under silent adversarial nodes and independent
honest downtime. The gated reference uses B = 500, k = 10 and C = 23; the draft's
candidate at 20,000 nodes and 20% adversarial membership uses B = 512, k = 10
and C = 24 and still needs validation.
The gate construction, beacon, handshake, epoch schedule and recovery exchanges
remain activation work. The website's calculators explore model estimates;
they do not certify deployment profiles or application delivery deadlines.

## Site

- [Overview](https://pubsub.cardano-scaling.org/): what the layer is, who it is for, and where the research stands.
- [Dissemination models](https://pubsub.cardano-scaling.org/experiments/): the five candidate models, their construction and forwarding rules, and what separates them.
- [Midyear presentation](https://pubsub.cardano-scaling.org/slides/midyear-2026.html): progress and direction as of July 2026.

## Repository

- [Source](https://github.com/input-output-hk/pubsub): Rust prototype node, deterministic experiments framework, formal models, and analysis.
- [Draft CIP](https://github.com/input-output-hk/pubsub/blob/main/docs/cip/README.md): protocol specification, supporting evidence, design comparison and open activation requirements; available for review.
- [Logbook](https://github.com/input-output-hk/pubsub/blob/main/logbook.md): running record of technical decisions, most recent first.
- [Biweekly reports](https://github.com/input-output-hk/pubsub/tree/main/biweekly-reports): fortnightly progress summaries against project goals.
- [Formal models](https://github.com/input-output-hk/pubsub/tree/main/formal_spec): Quint and PRISM models plus the per-model property analyses.
- [Prototype node](https://github.com/input-output-hk/pubsub/tree/main/pubsub-node): the Rust implementation and its experiments framework.

## Notes

- This is a proof of concept that has not undergone a security audit; it is not for production use.
- The baseline adversary is silent (receives and never relays). Additional experiments study wholesale admission flooding; they do not establish protection against general resource exhaustion, adaptive corruption or correlated outages.
- Deposits price node membership. Applications must establish which topics and publisher keys belong to an intended organisation; publication-rate limits remain open.
